sentences.text: Welcome home! Philippine Airlines flight PR 133 is bringing passengers back, nonstop from Chicago to Manila.
sentences.say: Welcome home! Philippine Airlines flight P R one three three is bringing passengers back, nonstop from Chicago to Manila.

sentences.text: This is the return leg of the airline's first-ever Chicago route, flown by an Airbus A350-900.
sentences.say: This is the return leg of the airline's first ever Chicago route, flown by an Airbus A three fifty, nine hundred.

sentences.text: Why does it matter? Filipinos are one of the largest Asian communities in the United States, with more than four million people of Filipino descent.
sentences.say: Why does it matter? Filipinos are one of the largest Asian communities in the United States, with more than four million people of Filipino descent.

sentences.text: Many families in Chicago and across the Midwest used to connect through other cities just to reach the Philippines.
sentences.say: Many families in Chicago and across the Midwest used to connect through other cities just to reach the Philippines.

sentences.text: Now there is one flight. No layovers, no missed connections. More time with grandparents, and an easier trip home for the holidays.
sentences.say: Now there is one flight. No layovers, no missed connections. More time with grandparents, and an easier trip home for the holidays.

sentences.text: For nurses, teachers, engineers and workers abroad, and the families waiting for them, this route is more than a flight. It is a bridge between two homes.
